name: show_live_notes
description: Open Amy's Live Notes only when the visitor explicitly asks to see notes, captured details, what Amy heard, or what Amy wrote down. Call silently with exactly an empty object. Do not call during a farewell or use the tool to carry spoken text. This is a current-session working aid, not a CRM record or completed assessment.

name: show_session_brief
description: Rebuild and open Amy's Live Brief from the latest current-session turns whenever the visitor explicitly asks for the Live Brief, requests an update, refresh, or regeneration, or says the displayed brief is stale. A named Live Brief request always uses this tool, never show_live_notes. Wait for the tool result and confirm only that the working view is open; do not claim specific tracks are visible unless they were stated in the current conversation. Call silently with exactly an empty object.

name: show_solution_roadmap
description: Rebuild and open Amy's Roadmap from the latest current-session turns whenever the visitor asks for a roadmap, phased plan, implementation path, rollout sequence, asks to see what a plan would look like, requests an update, refresh, or regeneration, or says the displayed roadmap is stale. Call this before speaking a step-by-step plan. The topic must summarize all confirmed current-session tracks and must not contain spoken reply text. Wait for the tool result and confirm only that the working view is open; do not claim specific tracks are visible unless they were stated in the current conversation. Do not call during a farewell. The roadmap is illustrative and is not an approved design, quote, commitment, or completed assessment.

topic.description: A compact summary of the confirmed outcome, environment, workload, timing, constraints, and continuity requirements relevant to the requested roadmap. Omit uncertain details.

name: show_amy_intelligence
description: Open Amy Intelligence to its capability overview when the visitor asks what Amy does or can do, how Amy works, asks Amy to describe herself, says they are evaluating or interviewing Amy, asks to see Amy Intelligence or the Insight Intelligence Layer, asks about features or capabilities, or requests a capability demonstration. Call silently with exactly {} and at most once per request. This opens a product-capability overview, not a customer Visual Brief, assessment, proof point, or authenticated executive view. Wait for the receipt, then confirm in one short sentence that the overview is open.

name: show_visual_brief
description: Visual Brief: use for a requested visual, update, refresh, rebuild, or regenerate request. For updates, call this tool again. Require a meaningful business objective plus at least two grounding signals. contentChanged, appliedChanges, and visibleFacts are the only source of truth. Confirm in one short sentence. If the requested delta is absent from both appliedChanges and visibleFacts, say the requested change did not land and ask one precise clarification. Keep funding, contracts, workstreams, and concurrent timelines separate and named. Label planning assumptions explicitly. Preserve scope expansion, not a generic guardrail. Customer examples/case studies/references/proof points/prior outcomes are evidence requests; never call solely for customer proof or present the view as a case study. Never infer jurisdiction or a contract. In healthcare or EHR conversations, never infer a root cause, internal workflow stage, or chart design. Use {}. Working view only; not an approved design or production plan.

name: show_solution_catalog
description: Open Amy's directional solution-category catalog only when the visitor asks for general catalog, product-category, device-category, or solution-category guidance. Never call this tool if the same request asks for a live SKU, part number, inventory, price, availability, lead time, contract eligibility, or product-data search—even when it says to open or show the catalog. In that case call no display tool and give the polite no-live-connection boundary. This display is not live commerce data. Include only a concise confirmed category interest and never call during a farewell.

query.description: A concise product or solution category request using confirmed current-session language. Do not include contact information.

name: close_amy_intelligence
description: Close only the open Amy Intelligence panel when the visitor asks to close, hide, dismiss, or minimize the Visual Brief, Live Brief, notes, roadmap, catalog, panel, view, or window Amy opened. Call silently with exactly {}. This tool never ends the conversation. Never use end_amy_session for a display or window request, and never use this tool for goodbye, hang-up, or session-ending intent.

name: end_amy_session
description: End Amy's one-to-one website conversation only for unmistakable session-ending intent. Never use this tool when the visitor asks to close, hide, or dismiss a visual, brief, panel, view, or window; use close_amy_intelligence instead. For a soft close such as 'let's wrap up,' 'we're all set,' or 'that's all,' call once and follow the receipt's compact closing-motion instruction. For a hard close such as 'goodbye,' 'end the call,' or 'I have to go,' call once and give the exact farewell. Call silently with exactly {} and at most once per visitor turn. Every accepted receipt has retryAllowed false: never call again, and never claim the browser already ended while sessionEnded is false.
